# bioexcel/biobb_cmip/cmip_prepare_structure

## Summary

Generate a CMIP suitable PDB input.

Generate a CMIP suitable PDB input from a common PDB file or a Topology + PDB file.

Nextflow adapter of the [CmipPrepareStructure](https://biobb-cmip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/cmip.html#module-cmip.cmip_prepare_structure) building block of [biobb_cmip](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_cmip) 5.3.1.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_CMIP_CMIP_PREPARE_STRUCTURE } from 'bioexcel/biobb_cmip/cmip_prepare_structure'

workflow {
    BIOBB_CMIP_CMIP_PREPARE_STRUCTURE(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_pdb_path` | yes | pdb | Path to the input PDB file |
| `input_topology_path` | no | zip, top, psf, prmtop | Path to the input topology path |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_cmip_pdb_path` | yes | pdb | Path to the output PDB file |
| `versions_biobb_cmip` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_cmip', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of CmipPrepareStructure properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_cmip_pdb_path: 'pdb']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_cmip container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_CMIP_CMIP_PREPARE_STRUCTURE' {
        ext.properties = [remove_tmp: true]
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
